after.prompt: Microsoft Defender XDR can use automatic attack disruption to contain an in-progress attack. How does this differ from Microsoft Sentinel SOAR automation?

choice_explanations.A: Defender XDR is built around Microsoft workload correlation and automated disruption. A SIEM such as Sentinel is broader log correlation plus SOAR you design. Neither is WAF, retention, or Key Vault.

choices.A: XDR can take coordinated Microsoft-workload actions; a SIEM still depends on ingested data plus detection and (often) orchestrated response you configure
choices.B: A SIEM always automatically disables Entra users with no configuration, and XDR cannot contain anything
choices.C: XDR is only a WAF, and a SIEM is only a retention label
choices.D: They are the same because both are Azure Key Vault
